bounded_gpt_regime.rationale: The Federal Reserve's commentary indicates a continued focus on controlling inflation, suggesting a hawkish policy stance. Growth appears to be stabilizing but not accelerating, maintaining a neutral stance. Liquidity conditions remain tight as monetary policy tools aim to curtail inflationary pressures. Additionally, US assets appear expensive on a global relative value scale due to persistent policy tightening.
key_quotes: The Committee is strong in its commitment to bring inflation down to its 2 percent objective.
We are attentive to the risks of doing too little or providing too much accommodation.
Current liquidity conditions are consistent with our monetary policy goals.

markets.question: Will the 10-year Treasury yield hit 5.0% before 2027?
markets.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the Treasury 10-year yield reaches or is higher than the listed value for any date between November 11, 2025 and December 31, 2026. Otherwise this market will resolve to "No".

The resolution source for this market is the Department of the treasury, specially the data listed under "Daily Treasury Par Yield Curve Rates" for the column "10 Yr" (see: https://home.treasury.gov/resource-center/data-chart-center/interest-rates/TextView?type=daily_treasury_yield_curve&field_tdr_date_value=2025).
